Wealthcall was adopted by the kiln workers. 
She had been sneaking around the kiln, drawn by the noise of firing porcelain. She was caught by Song Jiu's master. 
"Brothers, look! The Chai King has blessed us and brought us fortune!" 
Song Jiu was unconvinced: "Master, cats bring poverty, dogs bring wealth. We should've gotten a dog!" 
"Nonsense. This is definitely a lucky cat!" the master declared. 
Years passed. The master was gone, the Porcelain Kiln never did bring riches. 
Perhaps Song Jiu was right—Wealthcall was never meant to be a lucky cat. 
But her name never changed, and she's still there. 
As if that old master were still at the Porcelain Kiln too.
